mapper.insert: insert into article(title, content, preview, updateTime, createTime, tag, likes, views, authorId, author, cover, classify,pub) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{preview}, #{updateTime}, #{createTime}, #{tag}, #{likes}, #{views}, #{authorId}, #{author}, #{cover}, #{classify},#{pub})
mapper.select:
select a.* from article a, user_collection uc
uc.uid = #{uid} and uc.aid = a.id
and a.title like concat('%',#{searchData},'%')
order by uc.collectionTime desc
order by a.createTime desc
order by a.views desc
order by a.likes desc
